page.title: Our Year
page.subtitle: A shared look back, as often as you like — and a timeline that grows with you.

empty.heading: No chapter yet
empty.body: Start your first look back together. You decide which stretch of time it covers.

gate.heading: There is nothing here for you yet
gate.body: "Our Year" is only ever visible to one couple. Set up your own ritual — nobody else in this family gets to see it.

privacy.note: Everything in here is visible to the two of you only. No other account in this family has access.

setup.subtitle: A few details, then this space belongs to the two of you.
setup.intro: "Our Year" is a ritual for you as a couple: you look back together on a stretch of time you choose, compare your memories and keep what matters as a chapter. You don't need to be married, and you don't have to enter any particular date.
setup.partnerSelectHint: Both of you need your own account — that is what keeps your answers apart until you look at them together.
setup.noPartnerHeading: There is only one account so far
setup.noPartnerBody: Invite your partner. Once the second account exists, you can continue here.
setup.inviteHint: The link is valid for seven days and can be redeemed once.
setup.occasionLabel: What do you call this occasion?
setup.occasionHint: Just a name for the two of you — it commits you to nothing.
setup.rhythmRecurring: A day that comes round every year
setup.rhythmRecurringHint: Only for orientation. You can always look back earlier or later.
setup.rhythmManualHint: You simply start a new chapter whenever it feels right for both of you.

ritual.flexNote: This is only a reminder — you can start a chapter whenever you want.

chapter.newSubtitle: The title and the period are suggestions — change them to fit you.
chapter.titlePlaceholder: e.g. A year full of changes
chapter.titleHint: Examples: Our year 2026 · Our fifth year together · A fresh start
chapter.periodHint: A chapter doesn't have to cover twelve months.
chapter.deleteConfirm: Discard this chapter and everything in it? This cannot be undone.
chapter.readOnly: This chapter is complete and stays exactly as you left it.

reflection.title: Looking back on our time together
reflection.intro: You both answer the same five questions independently. Only once both of you are done do the answers become visible together.

questions.moment: What was your loveliest moment with me?
questions.laugh: When did you make me laugh hardest {{period}}?
questions.mastered: What did we handle well as a couple?
questions.more: What would you like to do with me more often?
questions.grateful: What are you grateful to me for right now?

reflection.placeholder: Write down whatever comes to mind first.
reflection.submitConfirm: After this you can no longer change your answers. Ready?
reflection.submitHint: Until you tap "I'm done", nobody can see your answers.
reflection.needAnswer: Answer at least one question before you hand in.
reflection.waitingBody: As soon as {{name}} is done, you'll see both perspectives side by side.
reflection.partnerDoneBody: Your answers are still missing. Take your time — {{name}} sees nothing of yours until then.
reflection.revealedHint: There is no right and no wrong. The differences are the interesting part.

quiz.title: Our couple's quiz
quiz.intro: Answer separately first, then compare. No points and no winners — different memories are entirely welcome.

questions.trip: What was our loveliest trip together?
questions.phrase: Which phrase did one of us keep saying?
questions.purchase: What did one of us absolutely want to buy?
questions.pointlessDebate: What did we argue about completely needlessly?
questions.laughedHardest: What did we laugh loudest about?
questions.kids: Who got up at night for the children more often {{period}}?
questions.meal: What was our best meal together?
questions.proudest: What are we proudest of as a couple?

quiz.ownQuestionPlaceholder: What do you want to compare?
quiz.suggestionsHint: Take what fits. Leave out everything else.
quiz.emptyQuestions: No questions yet. Take a suggestion or write your own.
quiz.lockedHint: The questions can be changed as long as nobody has answered yet.
quiz.submitConfirm: After this you can no longer change your answers. Ready?
quiz.needAnswer: Answer at least one question before you hand in.
quiz.waitingBody: As soon as {{name}} is done, you'll compare your memories.
quiz.partnerDoneBody: Only your answers are missing now.
quiz.revealedHint: No score, no winner. At most, note how it was for the two of you.
quiz.reactionHint: Optional — just for the two of you.

reactions.talk: We need to talk about this

letter.title: A letter to our future selves
letter.intro: You write this letter together. Afterwards it is sealed — until the day you choose yourselves.

questions.wishes: What do we wish for our next stretch of time together?
questions.remember: What do we not want to forget?

letter.placeholder: Write as much or as little as you like.
letter.openAtHint: Your next occasion is suggested. You can pick any date.
letter.sealConfirm: After this the letter can neither be read nor changed until {{date}} — not even by you. Seal it?
letter.sealedNote: Until then nobody can read it. Not even the two of you.
letter.waitingHeading: A letter from us is waiting for us.
letter.waitingBody: Written on {{date}}. Take a quiet moment for it.
letter.needText: Write at least one sentence before you seal the letter.
letter.needFutureDate: The opening date has to be in the future.

keepsakes.title: One picture, one song, one sentence, one moment
keepsakes.intro: Deliberately just four things. This isn't about collecting as much as possible, but about the essence of this time together.

photo.label: A photo of the two of you
photo.hint: One picture that stands for this time.

song.label: A song
song.hint: A song that fits this time.

quote.label: A sentence that stuck
quote.hint: Something emotional, funny or simply typical of this time.

summary.title: Before you close this
summary.intro: Take one more look at what remains from this time together.
summary.readyBody: You can close this chapter together now. Afterwards it becomes part of your timeline and stays as it is.

missing.reflection: Your look back — one of you hasn't handed in yet.
missing.quiz: The couple's quiz — one of you hasn't handed in yet.
missing.letter: The letter to your future selves isn't sealed yet.
missing.keepsakes: Keepsakes are missing: picture, song, sentence and moment.

summary.closeConfirm: Close this chapter? Afterwards it stays part of your timeline, unchanged.
summary.closedBody: Completed on {{date}}. It stays exactly as you kept it.
summary.letterPending: Your letter is still waiting for {{date}}.

letterWaiting.title: A letter from us is waiting for us.

partnerWaiting.title: {{name}} is waiting for you
partnerWaiting.body: Your answers are still missing in "{{chapter}}".

ritualDue.title: Your look back is due
ritualDue.body: {{occasion}} has passed. Start whenever it suits you both.
